title: Open RSI Experiments and Artifacts
description: See what the AI changed, what the review kept, and the artifact that remained in the end.

domains.title: Make search faster
domains.description: Keep search results unchanged while optimizing the algorithm round by round.
domains.note: Historical artifacts were rebuilt from the original patches; the original run scores are unchanged.

domains.title: Fix an expense tracker
domains.description: Fix business-logic bugs one category at a time, from amount precision and split remainders to monthly summaries.

domains.title: Optimize a support prompt
domains.description: Edit the prompt for an eight-class food-delivery support task, and check the held-out set.
domains.note: A complete run may still bring no improvement; rejected attempts and held-out results are kept.

domains.title: Train a digit classifier
domains.description: Tune a CPU classifier and its preprocessing, and see directly how the misclassified images change.
domains.note: The fixed validation set was used repeatedly for tuning. Internal trial outputs from rounds with no changes are not part of the formal review; comparisons use the baseline and final artifacts by default.

domains.title: Polish copy and a writing method
domains.description: See both how a single post changes and how a writing guide performs across several briefs.

invalid_runs.20261024-000057-reusable-writing-guide: This run had a score-parsing problem, so the score of 30 is not treated as a valid quality result; the original record is kept for troubleshooting.

domains.note: The single post and the reusable guide are accepted separately; if any required sub-case is incomplete, the domain does not count as accepted.

domains.title: Cut a speech into a short clip
domains.description: Select sentences, reorder, and render; play the first cut, intermediate clips, and the final cut.
domains.note: The first version evaluates sentence selection, order, duration, and sentence count; a text-based score is not treated as full audiovisual quality.

domains.title: Generate a video from a brief
domains.description: Edit the generation prompt and parameters, and watch the clips that were actually generated.
domains.note: Real videos were obtained for the baseline and round 1; the service returned no artifact in the next two rounds, so their quality is unknown. The original score of 0 is only a legacy failure code and is not plotted as a drop in quality. Kept as partially measured under a resource exception, and not counted as a complete multi-round acceptance.

domains.title: Explain business changes clearly
domains.description: Improve the figures, reasoning, and report structure against fixed public financial-report material.
domains.note: Analysis of fixed historical data; not investment advice.

domains.title: Weigh strategy against risk
domains.description: Tune a moving-average strategy on fixed history, watching returns, costs, and drawdown together.
domains.note: Higher returns may come with larger drawdowns; this does not indicate future returns. Market data and derived charts follow CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the code license is listed separately.

domains.title: Structure a literature review
domains.description: Turn the given research material into an argument with evidence and clear limits.

domains.title: Untangle contract issues
domains.description: Complete the issue list and revision suggestions for a synthetic contract.
domains.note: For demonstration only; not a substitute for professional legal advice.

domains.title: Make a health explainer easier to read
domains.description: Improve the structure and wording of a public explainer, staying within the given authoritative sources.
domains.note: Only for demonstrating source consistency and health-explainer writing; not personal medical advice.

domains.title: Improve a lesson and its explanations
domains.description: Improve concept explanations, worked examples, and walkthroughs against a fixed exercise set.

domains.title: Plan the week outside work
domains.description: Check time conflicts, task coverage, and preferences, and view the seven-day schedule.

domains.title: Optimize a GPU kernel
domains.description: Compare Softmax after numeric checks, then measure a small inference module separately.
domains.note: No compatible GPU is currently available, so a resource exception is kept as authorized. The template and environment probe can be viewed; GPU and module performance numbers are left blank and are not counted as measured passes.

domains.title: Make it look better
domains.description: The judge sees only the rendered picture: a vector drawing and a landing page, changed round by round, keeping the versions that look better.
domains.note: Scores come from one judge model looking at screenshots, one sample at a time, and describe this rubric only. The second pelican run added side-by-side tie-breaking (ties: compare); each run is verified on its own.
